ALPHA GUIDE 
Page 16 of 76 
 
Author of The Chronicles of Narnia and Oxford historian C. S. Lewis wrote: 
 
“A man who was merely a man and said the sort of things Jesus said would not be a 
great moral teacher. He would either be (insane)... or else he would be ‘the Devil of Hell.’ 
You must make your choice. Either this man was, and is, the Son of God, or else (insane) 
or something worse... but let us not come up with any patronizing nonsense about his 
being a great human teacher. He has not left that open to us. He did not intend to.”3
